name: scriptca
description: One TypeScript core (compiled by scriptc) → type-safe clients for Bun, Node, Deno, Tauri, React Native, Lynx, Cloudflare Workers, Vite, and Next.js

scripts.build: bun run --filter @scriptca/types --filter @scriptca/core --filter @scriptca/node --filter @scriptca/bun --filter @scriptca/testing --filter @scriptca/vite --filter @scriptca/webpack --filter @scriptca/next --filter @scriptca/react-native --filter @scriptca/tauri --filter @scriptca/lynx --filter @scriptca/expo --filter @scriptca/cli build && bun run --filter '@unikit-bridge/scriptca' build
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/scriptca/dist packages/*/dist-test examples/*/.scriptca examples/*/node_modules/.cache
